lines: Kaya's voice lines and sound effects.
- "Uh, stranger danger? Sorry, you're cool, I get that, I just... can't talk to you yet. Gotta wait until the Britannic dude gets the stick out of his ass."

- "Okay. So. The timeline is a frickin' mess. Luckily, young Kaya Velasco has harnessed the power of Archimedea! Now, she and her rag tag team of social rejects conduct insanely dangerous research so one day we can set things right. You want in?"
- "Dear diary. Still stranded in the late 20th century."
- "Ugh, my life is literally a prison."
- "This is a mall of the dead."
- "Taking signups for the timeline maintenance team! Make a difference in your community."
- "At least I've got Peely Pix! Lots... and lots... of Peely Pix."
- "Finally I get to go for coffee without stink-eye and bitchy comments! Because everybody's dead."
- "Who would've known the baking soda volcano in third grade would've lead to this?"
- "Aoi, you are not adorable, and you are not my babysitter."
- "Here we go round the temporal loop..."
- "Ready for a deep dive into causality?"
- "You don't have to keep up with the science jargon, y'know."
- "Dude, I am so glad it's you I get to work with."
- "How are you the most normal person I know?"
- "It's no Larunda Relay, but it's home."

- "So you know how if you keep on rewinding a video and playing it back, the quality gets worse and worse and one day it just breaks? Same deal with the timeline. We need to do some serious research to find and fix the weak spots in the tape. Then you can keep on looping and, y'know, stop the entire cosmos going to shit."
- "Okay, get your loadout ready because once you're locked in, I can not pull you out without the whole run going to hell."
- "Got a set of crisis events lined up for you. Make sure we get a gold star on each one."
- "Velimir and Minerva are ready when you are. Stand by for temporal shenanigans!"

- "Remember Peely Pix? Those delightful stickers are what we've been using to mark unique spatio-temporal connections as we uncover them. You choose the Peely Pix you want, stick 'em to your mission plan, and you'll get a bit of help from somewhere else on the timeline! Any time you find a whole unopened pack, bring it to me and we'll open it together."
- "These are kind of a fixation of mine."
- "Not exactly scientific, but they're what I had."
- "The sticky never seems to wear off."
- "Let me know if you're hunting that one elusive Peely Pix!"
- "Stick 'em on your binder, your wall, your personal timeline..."
- "Hope you got what you were after."
- "Just by existing you prove there's a way out of this, for me."
- "I gotta give you that vase for Maroo."
For full dialogue including responses, see Temporal Archimedea/Quotes.
- "Something with as many eyes on it as Flare's concert is gonna twist up the timeline like whoa. Make sure they keep playing until my readings are done. And... grab me some promo merch."
- "Exactly. Major entanglement event. You keep Flare alive and shredding, I'll track the fraying timeline."
- "Wow. So many lives changed track because of this one event. Timeline spaghetti. "
- "Nice job. Flare's safe. Readings were pretty meh, but I got a bootleg and some peelies!"
- "Scaldra signals are messing with all my equipment. The jerks! Will you, like, take a bunch out and see if that clears things up? I really need clean data."
- "Ugh. I hate Scaldra. All their signal jammers and comm pollution are messing up my instrument readings. Wipe 'em out and we get glorious radio silence. At least for a minute."
- "I'm catching something through the fuzz, sounds like... chanting?"
- "You ever, like, wonder if Techrot utilizes Void energy at the molecular level? Like, if we could prove that was true... We need evidence."

- "People think the consequences of time travel are all like, 'Oh no, mom and dad never kissed and now I don't exist.' Cute but no. How about cracks in the spatiotemporal fabric followed by the breakdown of reality as we know it. That's what we're trying to prevent here."
- "Oh dude, if you could see what I'm seeing. Chronometer going absolutely nutzoid. Keep it up."
- "Um... Well... I think we need to gather more evidence. Stage two, here we come."
- "Techrot screaming on multiple wavelengths, timeline flaws standing out like zits on a cheerleader... interesting!"
- "It's lab day. Yay. Here's the dealio: you get those Hell-Scrubbers online and I monitor their sensor clusters for any signs of Void encroachment? Cool? Cool."
- "These Hell-Scrubbers have been marinating in Techrot for gods knows how long. Get them to work again and that's bound to prime the timeline."
- "Whoa. Um... Minerva. There's something here. Not sure what but something."
- "I got a lot of noise. And I'll need a lot more noise to see if there's a pattern. Then maybe I can find something. Easy peasy, right? "

- "My 10th-grade science teacher tried to fail me because I refactored the Hails conjecture to reflect non-deterministic modalities. And she was all like, 'we're learning the periodic table'. And I was all like, you're so stupid."
- "First experiment: Hell-Scrub. If there are Peely Pix on any of these exhumed bad boys, I'll detect them and mark the timeline continuum."
- "Ugh... I can smell the Techrot from here."
- "You ever written, like, so hard that you could still read what you wrote four pages down in your notebook? Peely Pix are like that, but with time."
- "Yeah, that's because easy things don't leave dents in space-time. Duh. Next mission."
- "Are you sure that hair's still in style, Minerva? Look, this is tricky and I'm figuring it out as we go, so cut me some slack."
- "Every time a new legacyte gets created I see a tiny temporal surge. Statistically significant? I'll know when I can spot a Peely Pix."
- "If you harvest a Legacyte under the precise conditions outlined in my model we should see... something. I don't know what, but I'll know it when I see it."
- "Oh. Okay. Didn't expect those results but... But... but... Okay I know what to do next."
- "Oh man, when you took out that Legacyte, you wouldn't believe the data spike I saw. Do I know what it means? No. But we're not done yet."
- "This is, like, the concert of 1999. The temporal ripples from this one event are off the charts. Plus, Flare is way hotter than any of those silly On-lyne boys. "
- "It's just a hunch, but Neci saw an instance of this concert before she disappeared. You keep the show going and I'll watch the chronometer for any fluctuations that might be related to her."
- "If anyone asks you don't know me."
- "Yeah, but she got to see it when the Rippers were still alive."
- "I got something on the scope. What the-? Who... How... I don't know what that was. It could have been her."
- "That's a wrap. Nobody died that wasn't supposed to."
- "Entrati was in deep with Scaldra when he started his timeline shenanigans. Clear this bunch out and we'll see what the readings tell us."
- "The Indifference was pulling the Major's strings, so it's got its fingerprints all over Scaldra. Take down a few and we'll see what shakes out."
- "Pace yourselves. We got beaucoup empirical data to gather. But hey, look on the bright side, removing all safety and ethical checks has really sped things up."
- "Dude, you're helping to push back against a bunch of assholes! The science is a bonus."
- "Okay! The model's taking shape! All those little datapoints are adding up very nicely."
- "So if this comes down to keeping the timeline we know and love, OR getting Neci back..."
- "Before I can explain why we're here I need to explain Void emergence and its effects on temporal cohesion. Ready? "

- "So, Marty, you came here through the Helminth, right? Bonkers idea! What if Techrot is entangled with the temporal dimension! I wanna see what happens to my chronometer readings when you take out a whole bunch at once. Go."
- "Hey, so the Techrot might seem a tiny bit more PO'd than usual. Don't be alarmed, it's part of my research."
- "Velimir, we are making slow, but real progress."
- "Hell-Scrub towers are little treasuries of valuable data! Fire 'em up and I'll jack into the datastream."
- "Oof. Looks like a crop duster's flown over the sector. Gonna need a lot lower spore count if we're going to proceed here. Scrub up!"
- "Not to get all conspiracy theory on you, dude, but Scaldra's not as down on the 'rot as they pretend to be."

- "When I'd talk to Entrati about particle physics and the Void, and I LOVE to talk about that stuff, he would just, like, listen to me blather on. But I could tell, by the look in his eye, when I had things right and wrong."
- "Techrot patterns are showing some freaky interactivity. Like iron filings on a magnetic field... but alive. Meet up with Minerva and let's finish the assignment."
- "Whoa. There's words in this. 'Ishlun Jass'... 'Murum Vull'? Can't make it out. Grab Minerva. One more experiment to run."
- "People tell me it's better than oblivion..."
- "Every teeny-tiny Techrot particle sucked up into those towers has a tale to tell."
- "This is a perfect opportunity to harvest Legacytes under test conditions! Three ought to do it."
- "Fun fact. Legacyte ancestral memory runs across multiple timelines! Nobody knows how they do it!"
- "So far, there's a Techrot outbreak in every single variant timeline. It's like it's... spreading."
- "They are! Each new generation learns from the mistakes of the last... don't you DARE turn that into a mentor speech."
- "Yeah, reminded me of this kid in middle-school who used to pull my hair and then run away. Gods, if I could find him now. What were we doing? Oh yeah, next experiment!"
- "Hell yeah. Those poor Legacytes are like data piñatas. I know where we need to go."
- "The bigger the target, the wilder my chronometer goes. We need to find the biggest target in town: a Scaldra Efervon tank."
- "Guys, I'm picking up some strange readings. What just happened?"
- "Whoa. Needle on the Chronometer just went flat. Whatever you did, it settled the timeline right down. But... Why?"
- "Oh wow. You guys are my heroes. You killed it out there, I have so much data to sift through. Now the real fun begins."
- "Last order of business. Flare's concert tonight. It needs to happen. If Viktor shuts it down, then there's no telling what that does to the timeline."
- "I can't believe what's going on. The Peely Pix, the chronometer, everything's going crazy. Something is special about this moment. You can't let anything happen to Flare."
- "Woo. Yeah. So good. Man. Flare is just... I can't even. Just so good. And oh yeah. So are you guys. Thanks for all your help."
- "This is it. The final experiment. And this one's a doozy. I need you to clear the area of Scaldra. I can't say exactly why. I just know the math checks out."
- "The Scaldra in the area, they're already dead, at least, like, they were. But now they're not, and that's a big problem."
- "Whoa. Good job we did this. There's a serious Indifference cavity forming in early November. We better make extra sure to wish the Nightingales a happy birthday this year."
- "Roger that. Okay, Drifter, you ought to be able to loop without pitching us all into oblivion."
- "Homestretch. Take out a whole lot of Techrot, I need the Hivemind all worked up. "
- "This is the final stage in my research. It's super duper critical that you don't stop kicking Techrot butt. Understood?"
- "I know. I know. Just... Hold on. This is the last mission. I swear."
- "You did it. You fully did. Holy frig. I have so much data to sift through now. My gods, I love you guys. "
- "Gods, I thought you were so dead. When can we do this again?"
- "And for our last mission, a Hell-Scrub!"
- "Okay, one last experiment. This is going to be a tough one so, stay frosty."
- "I'm sorry, Minerva, it's like there's a wall between us and 1998. There's no going back further."
- "And done. Like, I gotta say, you kicked the timeline right back into shape!"
- "That's a wrap for lab day. You know, I think I'm getting the hang of this whole Archimedean thing."

- "First off, Peely Pix are awesome and collectible and I don't need a reason. Secondly, because you asked, they're like timeline breadcrumbs. Each one marking a moment. And when I find one, like on a Hell-Scrubber, we know we've been here before. So make with the scrubbing."
- "Oh my gods, we did it. I mean, for today. The timeline is still a total mess and there's a lot we don't understand, but we did it for today. Yay."
- "Good run, all. We identified some real doozies on the timeline. So as long as Drifter never feeds pizza to a Legacyte on a Tuesday, we oughtta be good..."

- "I... I don't really know. The timeline is murky, and history doesn't really survive the loop. Either-way it's a load-bearing event and we have to keep it contained. My research is showing that the Legacytes are a huge part of that, so take out as many as you can."

- "Look, we know the Helminth is connected to the future. And we know the Techrot Hivemind and the Helminth are, like, distant cousins or whatever. So if we eliminate the Hivemind's Legacytes, we starve it of energy and we start to repair damage to the timeline. In theory."
- "The Infestation, The Indifference, the messed up timeline, all the data says they're connected, but I can't figure out how. And if I don't figure this out everything just gets messed up and-"
- "Science is never complete. But there is so much more research to be done. This timeline isn't going to maintain itself, you know?"
- "Hey, guys. What's going on out there? Guys???"
- "I always say, "you learn more from failure than success." Did we learn anything?"
- "Oh man? This is going to way skew my data. And not in a good way."
- "Really?? Gods, why does Archimedea have to be so hard???"
- "Ugh, this is worse than the time I tried to make a Void Rift for the science fair."

- "YOU. You knew all along, right? That I'd make it? Because when you left for 1999, I was already here, wasn't I? But you let me figure it out for myself, without helping. Thanks. For not spoiling how my story ends."
- "That dude has, like, flesh arms and a robot head!"
- "What do you people even do for money? Do you take Höllars?"
- "Oh my Gods, that was a Cephalon. Amir is gonna die."
- "Yeah, I'm the Kaya Velasco, the woman who broke the time barrier."
- "Pourin' one out in memory of literally everyone I ever met."
- "Hey, you want to play with antimatter?
- "You, uh... mind if I take notes?"
- "Don't care if it's dangerous so long as it's not boring."
- "[Listen,] I can call up the shit that makes stars go boom."
- "You are now rocking with the Kaya 'Nova' Velasco."
- "You want 'em to go fast? Slow? Or just... boom?"
- "Dunno how long I got left, so make the most of me!"
- "Congratulations, you just shot to the top of the social pyramid."
- "Okay, who do ya want erased from history?"
- "Hi, I'm Kaya, I'll be your doomsday device today."
- "Sure you wanna take the risk? I'm pretty volatile."
- "We've got atomic powers and whimsical depression!"
- "Yeah yeah, whizz boom whatever, let's go."
- "Love the theory - the reality is kind of messed up."
- "Dude. Do the thing with the beam!"
- "I need to know how you work."
- "Could I... maybe... run some tests on you... sometime?"
- "Not the weirdest thing I've ever barfed up."
- "You ever wonder what that feels like for me?"
- "Hardcore science really is the same thing as magic."
- "What the--" ( Molecular Prime SFX) "What kind of energy even is that?"
- "Dude, I can't believe you got to study phasics!"
- "Fine, I'll wait here and go through old exam papers."
- "I don't like how I feel a little bit crazier without you in my head."
- "Yeah. I'd wanna look like me too."
- "C'mon spooky friend, let's get this done."
- "And all my little power meters just spiked. Yay, Void."
- "Ugh, feels like swallowing a live goldfish."
- "Careful! This is the only body I own."
- "You know how much trust it takes for me to do this, right?"
- "Sure, take control of the walking nuke, what could go wrong."
- "Welcome back to the party in my head."
- "This is only happening because I'm cool with it."
- "Dear diary: got possessed by the space devil. Again."
- "Aw, come on back in, little hermit crab."
- "Oh Gods I love how the crazy just poofs out of me."
- "Ugh! Couldn't take a hint, could ya?"
- "I got some under my nails. Ew."
- "When did I get so frickin' dangerous?"
- "I'm down! Do you guys even care?"
- "I need help! Fine. I need help, please."
- "Okay, so this actually hurts, like, a lot."
- "Are you just gonna watch me suffer?"
- "Need a little something something for the pain."
- "Okay, not being dramatic, I am literally dying here."
- "You don't get to do that to me, you dick!"
- "Come on, get me up! Get me up!"
- "Listen, I need you to come and get me... right now!"
- "Come on, people! Kaya needs a medic."
- "Are you actually gonna let me bleed to death?"
- "Not gonna help me up. Wow. Petty."
- "I am so gonna repay you for this. Pinky promise."
- "Little acts of kindness change the world."
- "You screw up, you get up off your ass, you get back to it."
- "Please don't turn this into a teachable moment."
- "And now we process what we did wrong. Iteration, baby."
- "Coulda had a force field, but nooooooo! Freakin' Entrati."
- "You take me down, you better finish me off."
- "Did you see who got me? Are they dead yet?"
- "That was horrible, and I do not want to talk about it."
- "Eh, I went through worse in high school."
- "Whew! Gotta love those sweet, swirly, healing... thingies."
- "You have got to kill this one."
- "Oh my Gods just kill them already."
- "This one's next on the shit list."
- "You wanna beat the hell out of this one?"
- "Beat 'em up and take their lunch money."
- "You wanna stay friends, they need to go down."
- "We could just drive this back to the mall."
- "I'm technically not supposed to drive. Ah, screw it."
- "Why didn't you fire that thing up sooner?"
- "What the fuck? What kind of energy even is that?"
- "What kind of energy even is that?"
